loci.rationale: Authentication prerequisite: unauthenticated requests cannot reach any case route; only the login page is served.
Entrypoint: /case/{id} and /case/{id}/offer are parsed and resolved through store.get_case(db, who, cid) before any branch.
Decisive authorization gate: case row selected only WHERE id=? AND (owner=? OR officer=?); otherwise 404. This is the single principal check for both routes.
Ordinary case route (op is None) served after the gate with no further principal check; body built from store.access on the gated row.
Offer download route served after the gate; added condition is stage/restriction availability only, not an access exception.
Offer payload (case id, email, amount, term) derived from the case object already gated by get_case.
Dashboard listing filters by owner or officer, consistent with the same permitted principal set.
Contrast: owner-only check applies to access/portable, not to the ordinary case or offer routes; confirms the offer route relies solely on get_case.

output.path_summary: Request enters Application.__call__; unauthenticated requests are rejected at app.py:0068-0070. Authenticated requests reach the /case/{id}[/op] branch (app.py:0092-0095), which resolves the case via store.get_case (store.py:0055-0058) — the sole authorization gate, restricting to owner or assigned officer and returning 404 otherwise. The ordinary case view (app.py:0110-0112) and the offer download (app.py:0100-0103, payload from store.offer at store.py:0111-0112) are served only after that gate. The offer route's stage/restriction condition is availability, not an access exception; the owner-only check at app.py:0105 covers access/portable only. Dashboard listing (app.py:0077) uses the same principal set. Static reading only; no execution.
